_comment: The Rune Gate declaration was missing, so the keyword was inert -- the same gap as vantom_banshee. The rest of the card was already implemented. 'For each hero who has lost {h} this turn' is approximated as the opponent's graveyard: per-hero life-loss tracking exists as a turn event but not as a per-hero ref the banish can iterate.

effects.prompt: Banish this face-down to banish from graveyards?
